name: Skewblock
description: Parallelograms leaning one way or the other, packing into a field that shears as you read across it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(26% 0, 101% 0, 75% 101%, 0 101%); clip-path: polygon(26% 0, 101% 0, 75% 101%, 0 101%); -webkit-transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
